caption: The drawing depicts a round, flat object resembling a decorative plate or shield, shown from a top-down perspective. The plate has a detailed border and features a central design of a six-petaled flower in a reddish-brown color. Surrounding the central flower are four additional six-petaled floral motifs, positioned at regular intervals around the perimeter of the interior surface. The main surface of the plate is rendered with a mottled texture composed of various shades of brown, dark brown, olive green, yellow, and patches of lighter tan or beige, suggesting areas of wear or oxidation. The floral designs are outlined in darker tones, with highlights in reddish and green hues. The background of the drawing is a solid, light beige color, contrasting with the complex, multi-toned appearance of the circular object. There is a small signature in red at the bottom right corner of the image.
title: Pa. German Plate
cluster: #19 — Ceramic Arts: Pottery, Stoneware, and Porcelain
